catalogue_name: GDG Essex Supply Chain Semantic Catalogue
description: Canonical business definitions for the synthetic Essex supply-chain scenario. These definitions are the shared contract for SQL, agent tools, skills and evaluation cases.
warehouse_scope: Single warehouse per snapshot; WH-ESSEX-01 in the supplied dataset.

inventory_snapshot.grain: one row per product per warehouse per snapshot

metrics.name: Available stock units
caveats: Use one snapshot date and warehouse scope; do not sum across snapshots.

metrics.name: Products below safety stock
metrics.interpretation: Products with available stock below their defined safety stock.
caveats: Includes both AT_RISK and CRITICAL products.

metrics.name: Critical inventory products
metrics.interpretation: Products with available stock below 50% of safety stock.
caveats: Uses the status classification captured in the snapshot.

metrics.name: Stockout products
caveats: A stockout is not inferred from on-hand quantity alone; reservations are deducted.

metrics.name: Shortage units
metrics.interpretation: Units required to bring each product up to safety stock.
caveats: Shortages are floored at zero per product before summing.

metrics.name: Inventory value at risk
metrics.interpretation: Estimated purchase-cost value of the safety-stock shortfall.
caveats: This is a replenishment exposure proxy, not lost revenue or a financial provision.
Join product unit cost; currency is GBP.

metrics.name: Supplier profile risk tier
caveats: Do not present this as a score calculated from observed delivery performance.

metrics.name: Supplier on-time delivery rate
metrics.formula: COUNT(delivered orders where actual_delivery_date <= promised_delivery_date) / COUNT(delivered orders with actual_delivery_date)
metrics.interpretation: Share of delivered orders that arrived on or before the promised date.
caveats: Exclude open and cancelled orders from numerator and denominator.
Return null when there are no delivered orders; never silently return zero.
This is observed performance, separate from supplier_risk_tier.

metrics.name: Late delivered orders
metrics.interpretation: Delivered orders that arrived after their promised date.
caveats: Does not count currently overdue open orders; those belong to fulfilment exposure.

metrics.name: Average late days
metrics.formula: AVG(DATE_DIFF(actual_delivery_date, promised_delivery_date, DAY)) over late delivered orders only
metrics.interpretation: Average delay among late delivered orders only.
caveats: Exclude on-time deliveries and open overdue orders.
Return null when no late delivered orders exist.

metrics.name: Total fulfilment orders
metrics.interpretation: All orders in the selected order dataset/period.
caveats: Apply an explicit order-date range when reporting a period.

metrics.name: Open orders
metrics.interpretation: Orders not yet delivered or cancelled.
caveats: Status is evaluated as at the dataset snapshot date.

metrics.name: Overdue open orders
metrics.formula: COUNT(order_id) WHERE order_status IN ('PROCESSING','IN_TRANSIT','DELAYED') AND promised_delivery_date < as_of_date
metrics.interpretation: Open orders whose promised date has passed as at the snapshot date.
caveats: Do not include late delivered orders; they are a separate historical performance measure.

metrics.name: Current overdue days
metrics.formula: DATE_DIFF(as_of_date, promised_delivery_date, DAY) for overdue open orders
metrics.interpretation: Age of each currently overdue open order, measured at the snapshot date.
caveats: The portfolio total is the sum across overdue open orders; use order-level values for prioritisation.

metrics.name: Delayed open-order value
metrics.formula: SUM(order_value_gbp) WHERE order is open AND promised_delivery_date < as_of_date
metrics.interpretation: Order value associated with currently overdue open orders.
caveats: Exposure indicator, not recognised revenue loss.
Currency is GBP.

metrics.name: Supplier-linked inventory value at risk
metrics.formula: SUM(inventory value at risk for products supplied by each supplier)
metrics.interpretation: Estimated replenishment exposure attributable to products supplied by each supplier.
caveats: This is a supplier attribution of inventory exposure, not proof that the supplier caused the shortage.
Each product is attributed to its primary supplier in the products table.
GBP is the currency.

metrics.name: Supplier products below safety stock
metrics.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) where available_quantity < safety_stock, grouped by primary supplier
metrics.interpretation: Number of supplied products below their safety-stock threshold.
caveats: Each product is attributed to its primary supplier.
Do not interpret association as supplier causation.

metrics.name: Overdue open-order value by supplier
metrics.formula: SUM(order_value_gbp) for open orders whose promised date is before the as-of date, grouped by supplier
metrics.interpretation: Value of currently overdue open orders associated with each supplier.
caveats: Exposure indicator, not recognised revenue loss.
Does not establish supplier fault.
GBP is the currency.

order_status.DELIVERED: actual_delivery_date is present and on/before snapshot date
order_status.DELAYED: open order and promised_delivery_date is before snapshot date
order_status.PROCESSING: open order not overdue and in processing
order_status.IN_TRANSIT: open order not overdue and in transit

answering_policy: Resolve relative time to the dataset snapshot_date unless the user explicitly asks for a different order-date reporting period.
State the as-of date, warehouse scope and currency for relevant answers.
Distinguish supplier profile risk tier from observed delivery performance.
Distinguish late delivered orders from overdue open orders.
Use null/unknown when a denominator is zero or data is missing; do not fabricate a value.
For rankings, state the metric and sort direction; include denominator for rates.
When attributing inventory or overdue-order exposure to a supplier, describe it as association/attribution, not proof of supplier causation.

For cross-domain supplier risk, aggregate inventory and fulfilment independently to supplier grain before joining; never join raw inventory rows directly to raw order rows without controlling fan-out.
clarification_triggers: User asks for current stock but no snapshot exists.
User asks for a trend but only one snapshot is available.
User asks for a financial loss amount rather than the defined exposure proxy.
User asks to compare warehouses although this dataset contains one warehouse.
